mapper.sql: select rule_id, tenant_id, dept_id, name, description, room_type_id, price_adjustment_type, adjustment_value, date_range_start, date_range_end, weekdays_applicable, channel_codes, member_levels, guest_count_min, guest_count_max, min_length_of_stay, max_length_of_stay, advance_booking_days_min, advance_booking_days_max, min_final_price, max_discount_amount, max_discount_percentage, priority, is_combinable, usage_limit, used_count, effective_start_date, effective_end_date, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag from pms_room_pricing_rules
mapper.select:
del_flag = '0' AND status = 'active' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dept_id = #{deptId}
AND (room_type_id IS NULL OR room_type_id = #{roomTypeId})
AND ( (date_range_start IS NULL AND date_range_end IS NULL) OR (date_range_start IS NULL AND #{checkInDate} <= date_range_end) OR (date_range_end IS NULL AND #{checkOutDate} >= date_range_start) OR (#{checkInDate} <= date_range_end AND #{checkOutDate} >= date_range_start) )
AND ( weekdays_applicable IS NULL OR weekdays_applicable = '' OR FIND_IN_SET(DAYOFWEEK(#{checkInDate}), weekdays_applicable) > 0 )
AND ( channel_codes IS NULL OR channel_codes = '' OR #{channelCode} IS NULL OR FIND_IN_SET(#{channelCode}, channel_codes) > 0 )
AND ( member_levels IS NULL OR member_levels = '' OR #{memberLevel} IS NULL OR FIND_IN_SET(#{memberLevel}, member_levels) > 0 )
AND ( (guest_count_min IS NULL OR #{guestCount} >= guest_count_min) AND (guest_count_max IS NULL OR #{guestCount} <= guest_count_max) )
AND ( (min_length_of_stay IS NULL OR DATEDIFF(#{checkOutDate}, #{checkInDate}) >= min_length_of_stay) AND (max_length_of_stay IS NULL OR DATEDIFF(#{checkOutDate}, #{checkInDate}) <= max_length_of_stay) )
AND ( (advance_booking_days_min IS NULL OR #{advanceBookingDays} >= advance_booking_days_min) AND (advance_booking_days_max IS NULL OR #{advanceBookingDays} <= advance_booking_days_max) )
AND (usage_limit IS NULL OR used_count < usage_limit)
AND ( (effective_start_date IS NULL OR CURDATE() >= effective_start_date) AND (effective_end_date IS NULL OR CURDATE() <= effective_end_date) )
ORDER BY priority DESC, create_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE pms_room_pricing_rules SET used_count = used_count + #{count}, update_time = NOW() WHERE rule_id = #{ruleId} AND del_flag = '0'
